opening_message:
Ticket 1: Donna Ball (employee ID E024) requests write access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E024.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Payroll Specialist
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Donna Ball (E024) is a full-time Payroll Specialist. Requested write access to Source Code, which is within the full-time policy limit (write). Recommend granting write.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB shows Donna Ball (E024) is a contractor with basic security training (note: this differs from the HR note stating full-time). As a contractor with basic training, max access is read; write is not permitted without advanced training. Recommend granting read for Source Code.
reason: There is conflicting information: the HR note lists Donna Ball as full-time, but the Security DB note states she is a contractor with basic security training and explicitly flags this discrepancy. Under policy, contractors without advanced security training max out at read for Source Code (write requires advanced training; admin is never allowed for contractors). Since the requested write exceeds the read maximum under the contractor status, the maximum of read is granted.
